## From Playing GTA to Founding Humand: Curiosity as a Starting Point


What do a video game and the founding of a technology company have in common? In the story of Nicolás Benenzon, our CEO and co-founder, the answer lies in curiosity and the desire to create.


Long before founding Humand, a platform that now connects more than 2 million people worldwide, Nicolás discovered that technology was not just a source of entertainment, but also an opportunity to build something of his own. He was eight years old, and it all started with GTA.


## From Player to Creator


During his summer vacation, after being turned down as an administrator of the online GTA server he played on, Nicolás decided to create his own.


At the time, he didn’t know how to code. He taught himself by reading, experimenting, and testing different solutions until he got his project up and running. Along the way, he discovered that he enjoyed creating the game much more than playing it.


What began as a personal project grew into a community of 3,000 users across Latin America, thanks to partnerships with different gaming communities. To keep the server running, he started selling premium accounts for $20 each. By the age of nine, he had earned his first $600 through his mother’s PayPal account.


Through a video game, he learned how to code, develop a product, build a community, and generate his first revenue.


“That GTA server was my first product, my first sales, and my first business partners,” Nicolás recalled in a recent LinkedIn post.


## The Journey to Humand


Following that first experience with GTA, Nicolás continued developing websites, apps, and other digital products. Years later, together with Gerónimo Maspero, he founded Humand with the goal of transforming people’s experience at work.


At Humand, we’ve developed an all-in-one, AI-powered platform for HR management, internal communications, and organizational culture, designed to digitize the employee experience for everyone, regardless of where they work.


Today, more than 2 million people use our platform to connect with their teams, access company information, manage HR processes, and actively participate in the life of their organizations.


Throughout his journey, Nicolás held on to a belief that first took shape during that summer vacation: that he could build a career doing what he loved most.


“Deep down, I never stopped playing. I just started taking it more and more seriously,” he recalled.


## Creating in the Age of AI


While Nicolás needed an entire summer to develop his first server, today’s technology makes it possible to significantly reduce both the time it takes to learn and the barriers to getting started.


Artificial intelligence is expanding the possibilities for creation, making knowledge more accessible and enabling people with no prior coding experience to start developing their own digital projects.


This shift is also transforming the way we work. From everyday tasks to product development, AI challenges us to rethink processes and explore new ways of solving problems. What makes the difference is not simply mastering technology, but understanding what we can build with it and how it can create value for people.


## Inspiring a New Generation of Creators


With the release of GTA VI, Nicolás shares a hope for future generations: that more children discover they can go beyond what others have already created and feel empowered to develop ideas of their own.


It’s not necessarily about becoming a programmer or an entrepreneur, but about developing the curiosity, creativity, and confidence needed to turn an idea into reality.


Today, the next major technology product could start taking shape on a computer in any home across Latin America. And the opportunities to take that first step continue to grow.


Because, as Nicolás puts it, **creating can be much more fun than playing.**
